explication: This repository is a research portfolio, not one integrated application: its README presents separate foundation-model architectures, training toolkits, and task-specific applications. The sampled code supports a few local workflows, including BEiT image dataset construction and Fairseq multilingual dataset loading; there is no evidence for a single user-to-result path across the repository. Nodes also retain the README’s major product branches. Connections are limited to relationships visible in sampled excerpts or SOURCE INDEX references; unsampled subsystems are represented without inferred internal wiring.
